jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager  (Hybrid - Boston/Waltham)
jobs.description:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner.  There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams .  Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started!

Revenue Operations Manager

Our Revenue Operations team is looking for an experienced individual contributor to join our established team.

A successful RevOps Manager makes Revenue Operations simpler, more scalable, and more data-driven. You will be a trusted partner who understands both the business problem and the systems behind it, independently drives solutions from idea through implementation, and continuously improves how our revenue teams work. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and leadership to shape how we operate and grow.

What You'll Do:

- Own cross-functional initiatives end-to-end, providing critical operational support to the rapidly growing Customer Success organization while contributing to broader Revenue Operations priorities.

- Gather business requirements and design scalable solutions across the GTM lifecycle, including customer onboarding and activation, strategic partnership buildouts, and sales process implementations.

- Connect customer lifecycle data to revenue operations and forecasting, including retention, expansion, and customer health metrics, while establishing data governance and closing visibility gaps across the revenue organization.

- Build executive-level dashboards and reporting that turn customer health, churn, retention, expansion, and operational efficiency data into actionable business insights.

- Collaborate  with System Administrators across the revenue technology stack to design effective data flows, implement system enhancements, improve data integrity, and drive adoption of new capabilities.

- Identify and diagnose friction across the post-sale revenue lifecycle, championing process improvements and translating best practices into scalable processes and operational playbooks.

- Partner with Revenue Operations Enablement, Strategic Planning, and GTM Strategy teams to translate business strategy into actionable roadmaps, processes, and scalable operational solutions.

- Pioneer and implement AI-driven solutions that improve productivity, automate manual processes, accelerate analysis, and create efficiencies across the revenue organization and broader business.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, leveraging data, systems expertise, and operational insights to influence decisions and drive measurable business outcomes.

- Communicate recommendations, project status, risks, dependencies, and outcomes clearly and effectively to stakeholders and senior leadership.

Who You Are:

- 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, or a related function, with demonstrated growth into strategic, analytical, and operational ownership.

- Understand sales methodologies, post-sale onboarding and customer lifecycle processes, and forecasting mechanics and can connect them across the broader GTM motion.

- Bring an advanced analytical mindset and can break down complex or ambiguous business problems, develop clear frameworks for analysis, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

- Strong Salesforce Sales Cloud proficiency, including reporting, flows, account hierarchies, custom objects, and business process automation.

- Experience with BI, analytics, or orchestration tools such as Tableau, and have experience developing executive-level dashboards and reporting. Familiarity with data warehouse and integration concepts is a plus.

- Led complex, cross-functional projects with ambiguous requirements and know how to bring structure to a problem, define success, manage dependencies, and drive initiatives through completion.

- Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to augment analysis, documentation, problem-solving, and coordination, and you're curious about new ways AI can scale your impact.

- Excellent communicator and documenter who can explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences, write clear business and system requirements, and present recommendations that drive decisions.

- Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership of outcomes, proactively identify opportunities, and work effectively both independently and cross-functionally.

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Analytics, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, such as management consulting or comparable strategic and analytical work.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience supporting large-scale CRM transformations, system implementations, or automation initiatives.

- Experience with Customer Success, sales engagement, marketing automation, or BI platforms.

- Salesforce Administrator or related Salesforce certification.

- Experience with lead routing, lifecycle management, territory management, pipeline processes, customer segmentation, and/or forecasting.

- Familiarity with SQL or advanced data analysis tools.

- Experience working in a SaaS or subscription-based business.

In addition, some roles may be eligible for additional on target commission pay or bonus. The compensation package includes health and welfare benefits including paid leave.

We’re dedicated to improving the quality of our product from a customer standpoint and have a true desire to enable the success of businesses, non-profit organizations, and community groups.

- You’ll have opportunities to grow your career. We encourage and support our team members to learn different aspects of the business, take on stretch assignments, seek coaching opportunities and professional development opportunities.

- A generous paid time off policy and a competitive benefits package that supports the health and well-being of you and your family

jobs.description:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner.  There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams .  Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started!

About the role

As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will serve as the primary strategic advisor to our Sales and Marketing leaders. Operating in a high-growth SaaS environment, you will translate business priorities into people strategies that accelerate performance, scale organizational design, and build high-performing teams. This role requires agility - someone who can balance high-level strategic alignment with hands-on operational execution. The HR Team is on-site in Waltham 1-2 days / week.

What You'll Do:

- Business-Embedded HR Partnership: Build trusting relationships with leaders and proactively translate business priorities into people strategies, anticipate talent needs, navigate ambiguity with confidence, and guide executive decision-making.

- Talent & Leadership Advisory : Facilitate talent reviews, performance management, engagement planning, organizational design and workforce planning. Coach and challenge leaders to differentiate performance and build leadership capabilities.

- Change Management: Guide leadership teams through growth, restructuring, and transitions, helping employees navigate change with clarity and minimal friction.

- Complex Employee Matters: Lead assessment and resolution of sensitive employee and performance issues and coach leaders to share ownership. Partner with People Operations and consult Legal as needed. Own the recommendation and know when to make the call versus when to advise.

- Compensation Partnership : Advise on compensation, talent planning, and Sales incentive structures that drive business results.

- Data-Driven Problem Solving : Leverage workforce analytics, business metrics, and sentiment trends to proactively diagnose risks and deliver actionable solutions.

- Cross-Functional People Team Alignment : Collaborate across Talent Acquisition, L&D, Compensation, and People Ops to deliver integrated, scalable program rollouts.

What You'll Bring:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 8+ years of progressive HR experience with significant HRBP tenure in high-growth tech/SaaS.

- Proven history of building trust and driving alignment by coaching, influencing, and challenging senior leaders.

- Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret complex people data to inform critical talent strategies.

- A hands-on builder who can easily pivot from strategic planning to tactical execution.

- Solid understanding of GTM structures, Sales compensation dynamics, and revenue-driving team performance a plus

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner.  There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams .  Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started!

We have an opening for a high-energy, detail-oriented Financial Analyst to join our Revenue organization with a primary focus on Deal Desk operations. In this role, you will be the strategic partner to our Sales team, helping to structure complex deals, optimize pricing strategies, and ensure all contracts align with our financial and legal guardrails.

You aren't just a "gatekeeper"; you are a deal architect. You will balance the need for aggressive growth with the necessity of maintaining healthy margins and scalable revenue practices.

*This is a hybrid role with work from our Waltham, MA office on Mondays and Wednesdays weekly*

What You'll Do:

- Serve as the primary point of contact for the GTM team for deal structuring, pricing, and commercial terms.

- Review and approve quotes and order forms, ensuring accuracy in pricing, discounts, and billing terms.

- Develop and track Deal Desk KPIs (e.g., average discount rates, approval turnaround time, and deal velocity).

- Assist in the tracking, reporting, and forecasting of operational KPIs and key business metrics, providing timely and accurate information to stakeholders.

- Build and maintain financial models to evaluate deal profitability, Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).

- Analyze historical deal data to identify pricing trends and provide recommendations for optimizing "floor," "target," and "list" pricing.

- Perform impact analysis on various discount structures to protect gross margins.

- Own end to end reporting for International Revenue Initiatives.

- Collaborate with the Director of Revenue Analytics to support various ad-hoc financial projects and analyses as needed.

Who You Are:

- A highly collaborative and detail-oriented professional with 3+ years of experience in a Finance, Accounting, or similar analytical role .

- Adept with revenue planning systems and possess strong foundational knowledge of profit and loss statements.

- Experience building and managing financial models, with a focus on detailed variance analyses that drive actionable insights.

- Proficient with Microsoft Excel and skilled in data analysis and financial modeling.

- Familiar with Salesforce or similar CRM systems.

- Excited about leveraging technology to drive efficiency and accuracy. You have the ability to use AI to build predictive models for revenue forecasting and are keen to explore and utilize new tools to enhance your work.
